answer: By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
